name: cpp-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of C and C++, kept locally: cppreference.com (the C and C++ languages and standard libraries), CMake, Clang, Qt 6 (guides and the reference of every class, QML and Qt Quick), GoogleTest, Catch2, {fmt}, nlohmann/json, Eigen, Conan, vcpkg and Meson. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look it up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of C and C++: the standard library (std::unique_ptr...), CMake commands, Clang, Qt classes and functions (QWidget, QObject::connect, QTimer::singleShot), Qt guides (signals and slots, model/view), QML types, GoogleTest and Catch2 assertions, {fmt}, nlohmann/json, Eigen, Conan, vcpkg, Meson. Returns 10 section ids at most.
